احتملت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلْتُ (iḥtamaltu) /iħ.ta.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمَلْتَ (iḥtamalta) /iħ.ta.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمَلْتِ (iḥtamalti) /iħ.ta.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمَلَتْ (iḥtamalat) /iħ.ta.ma.lat/: third-perso
